saw_lines: Discount designer buyers compare the same piece across several sites, then buy the one with the clearest price cut.
So the first-time buyer decides on the offer line alone, and the sale is lost before the price is seen.
Your 26 text ads on Google read like error messages, not offers, so write three new ones that open on the 10% first order offer.
